therapist_01.prompt:
The screen lights up. A voice, tired but warm, cuts through the ringing in your ears. Keys clacking somewhere behind it. "You're still there? Okay. Good. I've got you until the top of the hour."
"See the three lighting up? Those are the ones you reach for. The rest are still there. You just don't pick them up much."
"So. How are you walking in today? Don't think about it. Just point."

truth.playerText: Not great. I woke up on the side of the road.
truth.npcReaction: "Okay. Thank you." The keys keep going; she types while you talk, the way you learn to with forty people on your caseload. "I keep four little lines on you. You'll see them move. They're not a grade. Weather, not a verdict."

lie.npcReaction: "Fine." The keys don't stop. "Everyone's fine. My whole caseload is fine." A tired almost-laugh. "I keep four little lines on you. They move whether you tell me the truth or not." A pause. "That reading at the bottom is the lake. FEELZ pulls it off the county sensors. It doesn't care how anybody feels."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told your therapist you were fine.

picks.Happy: "Bright. The sun doesn't ask permission either. Okay."
picks.Trust: "Open hands. Hard to hold anything that way. Hard to drop anything, too."
picks.Fear: "Small and quick. Like something under a porch. It can stay there a while."
picks.Surprise: "Caught mid-step. Most of life is. Okay."
picks.Sadness: "Low tide. It always comes back in."
picks.Disgust: "Something you'd rather spit out. Your body's smarter than your mouth. Noted."
picks.Anger: "That one runs hot. Hold it a second before you use it."
picks.Anxiety: "Braced already, and nothing's even happened yet. Okay."

therapist_intrusive.prompt: "Quick one, it's on the intake form." Keys. "Some people get thoughts that don't feel like theirs. Uninvited. Loud. Like somebody else got into the room. Ever happen to you?"

truth.playerText: Yeah. There's... a voice. Maybe two.
truth.npcReaction: "Okay. That's more common than people think. You don't have to argue with them. Just notice who's talking."

byPick.Trust: "You said that like you meant for me to hear it."
byPick.Fear: "You whispered that. You don't have to."
byPick.Sadness: "That sounded tired. Thank you for saying it anyway."
byPick.Disgust: "You said it like it tastes bad. It's allowed to."
byPick.Anxiety: "Breathe. You said it. It's out now."

byGift.Surprise: "Keep an eye on your wheel. Something you didn't see coming just came in with that. Everyone you meet is carrying a feeling you don't have yet."
byGift.Sadness: "Keep an eye on your wheel. Something heavy just came in with that. Everyone you meet is carrying a feeling you don't have yet."
byGift.Anxiety: "Keep an eye on your wheel. Something restless just came in with that. Everyone you meet is carrying a feeling you don't have yet."
byGift.none: "Your wheel's fuller than most. Still. Everyone you meet is carrying a feeling you don't have yet."

truth.itText: Great. Now you've ruined the fun.
truth.soText: Go ahead, tell her all about us. She won't believe you.

lie.npcReaction: "Okay. I'll check the box." A pause. "If that changes, it's not a failure. It's information. Some feelings only show up when you let someone see you."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told your therapist you don't hear voices.

byPick.Fear: "You said that fast. Like it might hear you."
byPick.Sadness: "That came out heavier than a no usually does."
byPick.Disgust: "You say it like it's a dirty question."
byPick.Anxiety: "Mm. Your knee's bouncing, by the way."

lie.soText: Good. Keep quiet about it. We'll keep quiet about you.

therapist_02.prompt: "One more, then I have to take my two o'clock." A beat. "What happened in the {color:Anxiety}dream{/color}?"

truth.playerText: I don't know. Water. Something underneath it. I couldn't breathe.
truth.npcReaction: A pause. Then, quieter: "Thank you. Most people give me the short version." A soft click, a chart opening. "That's the lake, at the bottom. FEELZ reads it off the county sensors. It doesn't care how you feel. It stays clear when you don't have to remember what you told people." A breath. "The fish were the county's idea. Somebody decided data needed a mascot."

lie.npcReaction: "Mm-hm." A pause just a beat too long. "We can leave it there. I'll write 'client deferred.' I write that a lot." Another soft click. "That's the lake, at the bottom. FEELZ reads it off the county sensors. It doesn't care how anyone feels about it. It just keeps count." A breath. "The fish were the county's idea. Watch the fish."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told your therapist you didn't remember the dream.

outro.text: "I give everyone homework. Almost nobody does it. Here's yours anyway."
"This week, ask one person a question about their day. Then wait for the answer. You don't have to fix anything. Just listen."
"Try getting curious about someone this week. Ask how they're doing, then ask a follow-up. People can tell when you mean it."
"Take an interest in somebody this week. Notice what they're doing and ask about it. Curiosity's a good place to start."
"You told me about the water. It heard you too."
"The dream can wait. Dreams are patient. Lakes are more patient."
"I'll have FEELZ send you a reminder, so you can't pretend you forgot."
The call ends mid-sentence, the way her calls do. FEELZ goes dark in your hand, and the lake is very quiet.

FEELZ · HOMEWORK
Today's practice: reach out
Say hello to one neighbor.
Notice what they care about. Ask about it.
Listen a little longer than feels comfortable.
You don't have to fix anything.
She's writing it down. Everything you said. Somewhere a file with your name on it just got thicker.
Or she hung up and forgot you already. Which would be worse?
She knew. They always know. Four more people to fool now.
Did she? Did you even lie? What was the dream again?
